notes.title: The Playtest Is Now Live! Join Our Contest!
notes.content:
What's up, Moneymakers!🧺💸  

The Playtest is now live!🚀
It's a laundertastic day, people! Eddie Wiser's Wet Dreams Laundry laundromat is officially open for business! Well, or at least it's doing a little trial run before our mullet-rocking machinist has to close shop again to work out the kinks in his machines...


JOIN THE PLAYTEST!

What do you get to try out in the game?💸🧼
3 in-game days of operating Eddie's Wet Dreams Laundry laundromat

Several introductory tutorial tasks that will help you learn the ropes

Operating the Money Faker, a miraculous gizmo of Eddie's that lets you print fake bills

Serving incoming customers, accepting their payment at the cash register and collecting their laundry

Doing the laundry, of course! Get the right dry-cleaning settings, wash the clothes, and return them

Perforiming management tasks to make sure the day-to-day of the laundromat goes by smoothly, such as repairing washers, ordering new supplies, cleaning

Having a meeting with the don of the local mob, I hear he's a hoot and a half!

Exploring the curious surroundings, maybe there's something secret out there?


Contest! Win a free copy!🏆🎉
Yes, that's not all! We're also holding a contest for the playtest! 10 lucky winners will receive a free Steam PC key of the full game when it's released! Join our Discord server to play!



How to participate in the contest:

Play the game until you open the laundromat on the 3rd in-game day

Explore the game's world and poke around for some hidden objects until you discover a secret area!

Inside the secret area, you will find your own contest participation code.

Post the code in the #laundering-contest channel of our official Discord server. Don't worry, it doesn't matter if everyone else can see it.


OUR DISCORD CONTEST CHANNEL!


GOOD LUCK🍀 and wash that cash, Moneymakers!🤑💸🫧

But.. don't be afraid when the mafia knocks on your door...🍕💼

notes.title: SWAT Commander Is Now Available!
notes.content:
Officers, 👮‍♂️

The time has finally come! We are proud to report that…

📣 SWAT Commander is now available in Early Access!
This launch wouldn’t be possible without our fantastic community, so we’d like to right away take this opportunity to thank you all for the years of support and helpful ideas you’ve been sharing with us!

Leap into action and embark together with your squad on our first six missions, available in both single and cooperative gameplay with three different game modes each!

What’s currently available in Early Access?

 Single player gameplay with a computer-controlled SWAT squad that takes orders from you as its leader.
 Dozens of direct and sequential commands that allow you to carry out your perfect strategies for breaching, entering, clearing, and securing targets.
 Cooperative gameplay where you and your friends form a squad of your own with up to 5 players in total.
 6 missions set in distinct environments, telling their participants about different situations that required a SWAT intervention.
 3 game modes for each of the missions that alter their environments and objectives into new challenges.
 Over 40 items of equipment – weapons with customizable attachments, helmets, armor, grenades, different ammo types, and special tools that you configure for yourself or your operatives.
 A dedicated behavioral system that brings to life your officers as well as the civilians and suspects encountered during missions. With characters responding differently to various factors, your tactical skills will constantly be put to the test.
And many, many more features that will allow you to configure the challenge and experience you have with our game as well as possible.

Visit our game's Steam page and check out our release date trailer for more!

Join our Discord or let us know in our Community Discussions if you have any feedback you’d like to share or questions you want to ask about our game!

Over and out,
SWAT Commander Team

notes.title: New Game – Laundering Simulator!
notes.content:
Introducing Laundering Simulator!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432750/Laundering_Simulator/

Meet Eddie Wiser, the unlikely hero of our new project's story. Though he may not seem like it, Eddie's been handy with the hammer and wrench ever since he was just a wee troublemaker. 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/368fec66ea6ee80457e06640a4905e709fcbcdd2.gif

Always tinkering with one machine or another and with an equal penchant for running into trouble with the law, he eventually grew up to be a sly entrepreneur. And his brilliant scheme of the day is to run a laundromat as a front for a whimsical forgery workshop hidden away in its back! 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/e266a322c10beef24dc30697e57f2ca36dfef3c8.gif

What led him to such a wild enterprise? Well, it'll be your job as the player to find out as you help Eddie run his daily activities:

 Serving the laundromat's customers
 Repairing machines
 Decorating your venue
 Ordering supplies
 Placing all the different items and managing space
 Handling laundromat finances
 Assembling various counterfeiting machines in the back
 Selling the different fakes to your friendly neighborhood fence
 Accepting special counterfeiting jobs
 Dealing with the local mob and authorities
 Taking care of an infuriating grandmother

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40768937/13feb1c22441f26a42a7feb9cd8ada4af354f2ff.gif

Whew! Eddie's got his hands full, so he really needs your help! Check out Laundering Simulator's Steam page and add it to your wishlist!
